scaglioni.section_subtitle: Weight brackets & profit % per modality (Air / Sea / Courier), insurance and presets.
scaglioni.preset_hint: Applies the preset's 10 tiers and insurance values, overwriting the current ones.

scaglioni_vettore.section_hint: Specific agreements with an airline or quote provider. They replace the brackets above for that provider only; every other carrier keeps using the general brackets.
scaglioni_vettore.empty: No per-airline margins. All providers use the general brackets.
scaglioni_vettore.seeded_from_client: Tiers pre-filled from the client's general brackets. This is a copy: once saved they become this airline's own values.
scaglioni_vettore.seeded_empty: This client has no general brackets: define the tiers from scratch.
scaglioni_vettore.formula_hint: The % is a markup on the provider's cost: 160% means the client price is cost × 2.60.
scaglioni_vettore.example_text_fixed: from {kg} kg with a fixed amount of {amount} {currency}: cost {cost} € → client {client} €
scaglioni_vettore.err_no_tiers: Define at least one tier with a percentage above zero.
scaglioni_vettore.err_not_increasing: Weights must increase from one tier to the next.
scaglioni_vettore.seeded_from_clone: Tiers copied from the {carrier} agreement. This is a copy: once saved they become this airline's own values.

listini.listino_inactive_hint: Saved but not applied: this service is billed by profit margin (mode P).
listini.listino_archived_hint: This price list is archived, so it is not applied: {base} is used instead.
listini.house_fee_hint: Empty = the owner's default value is used.
listini.listino_missing_hint: This price list no longer exists, so it is not applied: {base} is used instead.
listini.no_prices: No prices for this price list
listini.subtitle: One row per service: rate to apply, coefficient, fuel and whether the client may use it.
listini.empty_hint: No service matches the current filters.
listini.bulk_hint: Tick one or more rows with the checkboxes to apply bulk actions (change type, block/unblock).
listini.base_profile_subtitle: Assigns the base price list of the chosen profile to ALL services. You can fine-tune individual services afterwards.
listini.type_base_desc: Standard base price lists for customers.
listini.bulk_forza_hint: If enabled, it also overwrites blocked or already customized services.
listini.matrix_subtitle: Price per kg by shipment weight and destination zone.
listini.preview_hint: Includes client fuel ({fuel}%). Shipment supplements not included.
listini.preview_empty: No price for this weight/zone in the client price list.
listini.preview_prompt: Enter a weight and press Calculate to see the client price by zone.
listini.preview_suppl_note: Excludes destination-based supplements (COD, insurance, country, province…): they only exist when quoting a real shipment.
listini.note_extras: Cell sub-values: min/base/2nd parcel when applicable.
listini.note_step: Price is multiplied by weight every {kg} kg.
listini.extra_weight_hint: Price applied per each extra unit beyond the last weight tier.
listini.only_selected_hint: Block every other service, leaving only the selected ones available.
listini.only_selected_confirm: {keep} selected service(s) stay available and {block} will be blocked.
listini.only_selected_note: Blocking does not delete the assigned price list: it only prevents the client from using the service.

help.agent_iata_code: AWB agent iata code — Used in MAWB and HAWB cargo
help.alert_fax: Alerts by fax — Send alerts of problems with individual shipments to the headquarters fax.
help.alert_mail: Alert by eMail — Send alerts of problems with individual shipments to the headquarters email address.
help.aliquota_IVA: VAT rate to be applied — VAT rate to be applied on invoice mentionig the letter of intent
help.ass_minimo: Min insured — Min amount under which the insurance is not asked to the courier, and is covered by TMWE / the partner
help.at_place: AWB at place — Used in MAWB and HAWB cargo
help.autoblocco14gg: Insolvent autoblock — Automatically block after 14 days from the due date of the invoices. Since the reminders are after 7 days, they will be blocked per second
help.b2b_codcli_obbl: B2B internal ref. mandatoryr — Makes the field internal ref. mandatory in B2B express shipments
help.b2b_codcli_reg: B2B ref. internal regexp: — Any regular expression formula to control the format of the field. Put the regular expression and (separate from UMAN ) the "human" format to show in the alert Example: [0-9]{2}-[0-9]{5}-[0-9]{3}UMAN XX-XXXXX-XXX
help.b2b_footer: Footer text for customer B2B panel — Used in the footer of B2B customer panel
help.blocca_CORR_2: Block BRT — The customer doesn't want to use BRT
help.blocca_CORR_3: Block DHL — The customer does not want to use the DHL courier
help.blocca_CORR_3338: Block PalletWays — The customer does not want to use the PalletWays courier
help.blocca_CORR_5: Block FedEx — The customer does not want to use the FedEx courier
help.blocca_CORR_7: Block UPS — The customer does not want to use UPS
help.blocca_CORR_8: Block TNT — The customer does not want to use TNT
help.blocca_corriere: Block if courier — Se è un corriere i relativi servizi non verranno utilizzati da nessuna parte nell'ERP. Utile in caso di problemi bloccanti con le relative API
help.bloccato: Customer blocked — It inhibits the possibility of inserting new shipments to the customer, still allowing him to log in to see the previous shipments.
help.cargo_airport: Cargo Airport — Airport pick up/drop off of cargo flights
help.causale_IVA: VAT reason other — VAT reason to be used on invoice as an alternative to the default one
help.cell: Mobile phone — Mobile phone of the contact to which any SMS will be sent from the SW
help.cf: Tax ID. — Tax code, only if different from the VAT number. If private, put the CF in the other field
help.cod_destin: Recipient code — Code for electronic invoicing to Italian customers
help.delivered_mail: Send a notification message to the headquarters email when shipments are delivered.
help.descriz_settore: Other sector — Other operating sector not listed or clarifications on the one indicated
help.diritto_fisso: Fixed invoicing fee — Amount charged for accounting management and the issuance and shipment of the invoice.
help.fastlink: Use fastlinks — If selected, the customer's fast link will be shown for quick entry of pickups and shipments.
help.fatt_lingua: Billing language — Invoice show language (applies only to PDFs, XML will always and only be in Italian/base language)
help.fatt_sped_fax: Send invoice by fax — The customer has requested that the invoice be sent by fax
help.fatt_sped_posta: Send invoice by post — The customer requested the shipment of the paper invoice
help.fattura: Automatic invoice issue — Issue invoices automatically or manually, in the case of non-standard procedures and/or descriptions.
help.fax: Fax — Fax del contatto al quale verranno inviati gli eventuali fax dal SW
help.id_autista: Pick-up driver — Driver picking up in this site. If not selected and the zip code is not covered in drivers_zone, pickups will be made by courier.
help.id_autista_cons: Delivery driver — Driver delivering to this site. If not selected, the one set for the destination zip code will be used
help.id_causale_IVA: VAT Reason — VAT description to be indicated on the invoice, in particular in the case of letters of intent for exemption or rate reductions
help.id_contatto_tipo: Category — Category of the role played in the company by the contact
help.id_sede_interna: Sede interna — Sede, della società indicata, alla quale fa riferimento il contatto
help.id_settore_cliente: Customer's sector — Useful for statistics, targeted offers and above all for tax sector studies
help.issuing_carrier: AWB Issuing_carrier — Used in MAWB and HAWB cargo
help.label: Site short name — Name that will be displayed in the drop-down list for the location of the contacts.
help.ldv_corriere_sepresa: LDV courier triang. — Allow printing of courier Airway bill when Piickup is made at different place
help.legale: Legal practice — Indicates whether the client has an ongoing legal practice and/or has had one in the past
help.lingua_tel: Language to use on the phone — Language to be used in any telephone contacts with the contact
help.lingua_trad: Authorized Translator Access — For this language only from b2b.tmwe.it/testi.php
help.lingua_web: Language for the B2B website — View the website in this language
help.logistica: Logistics — Logistics office for Excel delivery import, visible only in the select of that function and not modificable by the customer
help.mail: e-Mail — e-Mail del contatto al quale verranno inviati gli eventuali e-Maildal SW
help.metric_imperial: Unit of measurement — Unit of measure with which weights and measures are entered. Metric or imperial The data will be automatically converted by the sw based on the data entered in the shipments.
help.nome_breve: Couriers nick name Short name used in vendor listings of service offerings
help.nome_from: Name from — Name shown before phone in labels as sender
help.note: Note — enter any notes about the company here
help.pec_fatture: Send invoice via PEC — Select to send a copy of the invoice also by PEC email
help.pec_solleciti: Send reminders via PEC — Select to send payment reminders also by PEC email
help.pi_cf: VAT number — VAT number or tax code if different, indicate the tax code in the appropriate field.
help.presa_fissa: Fixed pick up — Make a fixed pick up in this site
help.presa_limite: Deadline — Time limit for requesting a pick up on the same day
help.presa_ora: Pickup time — Time at which to pick up
help.rag_soc: Company name — Indicate the name of company
help.ruolo: Role — Role that the contact plays in the company
help.scad_listino: Pricelist expire date — Expiry date of the price list for commercial renewal alerts
help.scelta_corr_perc: Courier choice % — Charge percentage applied for choice courier. Applied on the difference between the minimum cost and the cost of the chosen courier
help.scelta_forn: Courier Choice — Valid for couriers only, show or don't show in the B2B and ERP side dropdown of the same name.
help.sigl: Ruolo — Eventuale etichetta che verrà aggiunta al mittente nelle etichette, dopo " - ", ove popolata. Essendo accodato al nome del cliente fare attenzione alla lunghezza complessiva che non deve superare i 35 caratteri
help.signature_agent: AWB signature agent — Used in MAWB and HAWB cargo
help.signature_ragsoc: AWB signature — Used in MAWB and HAWB cargo
help.solleciti_invia: Send reminders — Send automatic reminders to the registry
help.text_quot_vettori: Base text for quotation request to airlines
help.tipo: Registration type — Type of registration: Customer, Generic Supplier, Carrier (shipping provider) or Internal for other registrations such as your own.
help.tipo_pagamento: Payment term — Method of debiting/invoicing the customer, in Advance, at the Monthly Summary or deducting from a prepaid.
help.tipo_record: Commercial Contact — The registry is a business contact not yet a real customer
help.unisciprescons: Pickup/delivery unic — Make a single daily round by combining deliveries with pick ups. Otherwise it unifies them only if picked up in the morning.
help.upsfull: Ignore UPS Zip code check — Ignore the zip code check to not use UPS when using SDA to deliver
help.url_real: Tracking URLs — Direct URL to shipment tracking. Only the AWB of the shipment will be added
help.valuta_sigla: Currency used — Currency in which to show the prices of new services.

users.subtitle: Admin user management (contatti)
users.empty_hint: No users match the current filters.
users.field_legacy_role_hint: Historical ruolo field. For modern RBAC use the roles panel.
users.api_only_hint: User authenticates only via OAuth2 client credentials. Useful for B2B integrations.
users.credentials_warn: These credentials are shown only once. Save them now.
users.reset_password_confirm: You're about to generate a new password for {name}. The current one will stop working immediately.
users.reset_password_warn: The user will lose access until they receive the new password.
users.delete_message: User {name} will be deactivated. They are not permanently deleted, you can reactivate them manually.

detail.no_oauth_clients: This user has no OAuth clients. Create one from the OAuth Clients section to enable API access.

security.no_overrides: No overrides. Permissions come entirely from the assigned role(s).
security.endpoint_restrictions_hint: With no rows, the user has normal access based on their Auth flags and roles. A 'deny' row blocks that specific endpoint. An 'allow' row activates strict whitelist mode: the user can ONLY access endpoints listed with 'allow', regardless of their Auth flags.
security.whitelist_empty_warning: Whitelist mode is active but no endpoints are allowed. This user would have no access at all.
security.clear_all_restrictions_confirm: This will remove all endpoint restrictions. The user will revert to normal access based on their Auth flags and roles. Continue?

auth_flags.capabilities_subtitle: Functional permissions for the user. Each checkbox grants the permissions listed in the tooltip.
auth_flags.filters_subtitle: Restrict what data the user can see (not what they can do).
auth_flags.warning_auth18_covers_auth20: auth_18 (Billing Admin) already includes invoice read. auth_20 is redundant.
auth_flags.warning_filters_bypassed: auth_18 (Billing Admin) bypasses active filters. The user will see ALL partner data.

bulk.grant_hint: Selected users will receive the specified role. If they already had it, nothing changes.
bulk.revoke_hint: The specified role will be removed from selected users. They keep any other roles they had.
